full_judgment: 24. The registration was obtained by the BCIC in 1979 and the application before the High Court Division was filed in November 1988 i.e. after expiration of 7 years from the date of the registration. In such a case there is a presumption of validity of the registration except in the circumstances mentioned in the aforesaid section. It seems that the respondents brought the allegation of fraud in order to overcome the presumption as under section 24 of the Act. It has been found that there was neither fraud nor absence of sufficient cause as under sub-section (2) of section 46 and as such the petition of respondent Nos. 1-3 was not maintainable. The findings made by the learned Judge himself were sufficient for a dismissal of the application.
